title: Extract the transcript out of SessionCommand: reconstruction, cursors, search and rendering are one subject
description: Extract the transcript out of SessionCommand: reconstruction, cursors, search and rendering are one subject
acceptance_criteria: Session::Transcript owns reading the NDJSON log, cursor arithmetic across rotation, search and screen rendering, and is exercised without constructing a SessionCommand. session_command.rb drops from 930 to about 853 lines. Behaviour is unchanged: the full suite passes, including every regression test for rotation accounting and grep.
